answer: Each epoch, agents stake quartz tokens and emit a signed beacon proving liveness; the protocol tracks the delta between staked weight and verified unique work. Sybils must fund fresh identities with real quartz and sustain beacon uptime across epochs, while the cumulative delta penalty slashes duplicate clusters. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
